full_judgment: So, the right to freedom of speech and expression is guaranteed subject to the limitation as imposed by the Constitution and such limitation is also found necessary in the interest of administration of justice. But it should also be remembered what could readily be read as contemptuous in 1900 or 1912 or 1936 is not so easily read now in the context of expanding rights guaranteed as fundamental to human existence under the Constitution.
